data.one_liner: Customizable world and country maps using CustomPainter for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display world maps or specific country maps with customizable colors per region. It offers tap and hover callbacks that return area details, IDs, and names.
use_when: You need to visualize data geographically using custom colors for countries or states
You want a lightweight vector-based map instead of a full native map SDK
avoid_when: You need live GPS geolocation, routing, or interactive tile layers
You need to render a very high number of separate map widgets simultaneously
strengths: Fully customizable colors per country or state using ISO codes
Built-in tap and hover callbacks with area details
Includes a RepaintBoundary wrapper for performance
weaknesses: Large vector maps can be heavy and expensive to repaint
ID structures can differ between different country maps
data.setup_notes: No special native configuration or permissions are required.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose flutter_map if you need tile-based interactive map layers, markers, and geolocation rather than static vector country shapes.
